hooks.text: 五世界战役的关卡动态变化，敌人组合丰富且Boss会持续进化
hooks.excerpt: A five world campaign mode with dynamically changing levels and tons of enemy variation - including epic evolving bosses
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 可替换飞船并配置升级牌组塑造每轮玩法，另有六种独立模式
hooks.excerpt: Alternate ships and configurable upgrade decks to mold your run with Three difficulty modes suited for all players, including a "Revolution" campaign mode for maximal challenge Six alternate game modes, like Classic, Gates and Assault
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 手工攻击波、关卡和Boss被随机组合叠层，让胜负依赖临场技巧而非背板
hooks.excerpt: With Sektori I wanted to create a shoot'em up where every run feels familiar, but is still completely unique. A game of skill, not memorization. The hand crafted attack waves, levels and even the bosses are combined, randomized and layered with the upgrade systems in a way that creates an interesting challenge for every run.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
